name: docs-system
title: Documentation System
job_to_be_done: Bootstrap and maintain a reachable, single-owner documentation system in any repository. Use for documentation create/change/review/refactor, missing documentation entry or owner routing, broken links, or duplicate truth. Do not use for one-off prose with no durable owner, general copy editing, or documentation already governed by a more specific project workflow.

trigger_surface.description: Bootstrap and maintain a reachable, single-owner documentation system in any repository. Use for documentation create/change/review/refactor, missing documentation entry or owner routing, broken links, or duplicate truth. Do not use for one-off prose with no durable owner, general copy editing, or documentation already governed by a more specific project workflow.
should_trigger: Bootstrap a documentation system in this repository; it has docs but no clear entry or owners.
Refactor these repository docs so every durable claim has one canonical owner.
Review our documentation graph for broken links, orphans and duplicate truth.
Create a new architecture document and register it in the correct documentation entry.

should_not_trigger: Polish this one-off announcement; it will not be maintained as repository documentation.
Translate this README into Chinese without changing its documentation structure.
Summarize this document for me without editing the repository.
Fix this Python function and leave the docs unchanged.

edge_cases: Update this API reference using the project's existing API-doc generator workflow.
Write a standalone blog post based on this repository.
Review whether the implementation matches the current architecture document, but do not change docs.
Draft a proposal idea in chat only; do not create a repository artifact.
